feeds.title: Mrs Casual
feeds.description: Hi Everyone! I'm Jenn aka Mrs.Casual, My personal style is casual, comfortable, and meant for the everyday girl because that's what I am! Mrs Casual loves to shop and share daily outfits, major sales, and clothing tips on her teacher, mom, and women's style blog!

feeds.title: The Fashionably Broke Teacher
feeds.description: Lindsey Fillman is a fashion, lifestyle, + travel blogger currently living outside of Philadelphia. The Fashionably Broke Teacher started as a way to document her personal day-to-day style as a 4th-grade elementary teacher. It has since grown to a place where she shares affordable fashion & beauty favorites, outfit ideas, travel guides, and everyday life with her fiancé John.

feeds.title: Elizabeth Capone
feeds.description: A mom, teacher & exercise enthusiast (only because I love to eat and drink). Sharing some inspiration and motivation to help you find your happy place.

feeds.title: Teachers Have Lives Too! Teaching, Wearing and Living
feeds.description: Hi! I'm Erika. This blog is focused on fashion, teaching, and teaching fashionably. Teaching, Wearing and Living a blog for a teacher who tries to do all three.

feeds.title: More to Mrs. E » Fashion
feeds.description: Get Fashion tips and Outfit ideas, Beauty Recommendations and DIY projects for the busy teacher or working professional from More to Mrs. E. Encouraging balance beyond the workplace!

feeds.title: Dressing With Class
feeds.description: Hi there! I am an elementary teacher, and I love getting dressed up for school. This is just my little way of sharing some of my favorite things to wear to class!

feeds.title: Teacher Fashionista
feeds.description: I'm Jules, and I am a kindergarten teacher in Arizona. My passion is definitely teaching little children! This is an affordable fashion blog from a teacher.
